thread:
Carla (CSM): @Nora :wave: kicking off Pinecrest onboarding — quick thread to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a 30d rollout plan. High-level goals: 1) staging integration + sample traffic; 2) validate latency/cost for key routes; 3) enablement for engineering + PMs. Proposed owners: Nora (customer), Devon (impl), Arjun (solutions). Proposed kickoff call: Mon 03/28 10:00 PT. Agenda: intros, VPC/network checklist, API keys, smoke test, success metrics, enablement schedule. Confirm owners + availability and any org-level constraints.
Carla (CSM): Quick note on success criteria I want us to agree on before the call: a) p95 latency < 300ms for text-gen (first 512 tokens) in staging under representative load; b) embedding batch throughput >= 1000 reqs/min with <2s median; c) documentation + one recorded training session delivered to Pinecrest devs. We can refine on the call.
Nora (Pinecrest PM): Thanks Carla — Monday works for us. Primary internal stakeholders: me (PM), Sam (Backend lead), Priya (Security), and Julian (SRE). One ask: Priya needs a network diagram and KMS approach ahead of the call. Can we surface that?
Devon (Implementation Eng): Got it. I'll put together the network/VPC checklist and the required egress rules. Will also include the minimal ports and IP ranges for the Redwood staging endpoints. Draft ETA: EOD Fri.
Devon (Implementation Eng): quick snippet for testing once keys are provisioned:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference-staging.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3-small","input":"hello"}'
```
Devon (Implementation Eng): also flagging that if Pinecrest wants private deployment we need to start the security questionnaire early — can Nora confirm which deployment mode they expect?
Nora (Pinecrest PM): For now we want Hosted API with VPC peering — not full on-prem. Priya will still review the questionnaire but peering is the plan.
Arjun (Solutions Eng): I'll own the smoke test and baseline perf run. Plan: 1) run single-client p95 baseline; 2) 5-min burst sim (~50 RPS) to validate KV cache behavior; 3) sample embedding batch test. Success thresholds: p95 < 220ms (text-gen single-client), <= 2s median for embedding batch. I'll upload results to the kickoff doc.
Lena (Success Ops): I'll handle enablement scheduling and feedback capture. Proposed cadence: 30-min weekly sync for first 4 weeks + a 1-hour enablement deep-dive in week 2. I'll create a quick survey (3 questions) after week 2 to capture early friction points. I'll also record sessions for on-demand access.
Carla (CSM): Great — assigning action items:
- Devon: network checklist + curl example (due EOD Fri) ✅
- Arjun: smoke test plan + thresholds (deliver before kickoff) ✅
- Lena: enablement calendar invite + feedback form (draft by Mon) ✅
- Nora: confirm peering contacts + security reviewer (Priya) (confirm before call) ✅
I'll put a calendar invite for Mon 03/28 10:00 PT and attach the SOW + onboarding playbook.
onboarding-bot: Document created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/PINECREST-ONBOARD-3050012345 — contains checklist, SOW excerpt, and runbook.
Nora (Pinecrest PM): Thanks everyone. One more item — Sam wants to validate retention policy for logs and whether Redwood can redact tokens at ingestion. Priya will follow up with security questions in the doc.
Devon (Implementation Eng): noted. I'll add the log retention options and the recommended masking pattern to the playbook.
Arjun (Solutions Eng): small ops note — if you expect multi-tenant traffic patterns we'll need to tune batching windows. If Pinecrest can share a 24h sample traffic profile (even synthetic) that would help.
Carla (CSM): Action for Nora: drop a sample traffic profile or an estimate (RPS, typical seq length) into the doc before EOD Fri if possible. That will let Arjun/Devon prep realistic tests.
Lena (Success Ops): I'll include a Loom link template for recording the enablement session and a short checklist for post-session feedback.
Carla (CSM): Thanks all — will post the calendar invite + preliminary agenda in the doc. If anyone wants to add items to the kickoff agenda ping me here or add directly to the page. :thumbsup:
Nora (Pinecrest PM): Added Priya and Sam to the doc. See you Monday.
